theorems.label: maximum-cycle-cover-supplied-pathwidth-w1
theorems.statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Maximum Cycle Cover within the stated running time. 2^(o_eff(p log₂(p+2))) B^(O(1)). The graph is connected, bipartite, and has maximum degree at most eight. The exponent h(p) is finite and nonnegative and the ratio h(p) / max(1, p log₂(p+2)) converges to zero with a computable modulus. The supplied path decomposition and binary threshold count in the complete input length.

title: An effective pathwidth lower bound for Maximum Cycle Cover
